name: Hydra applier
description: The final go/no-go on a pipeline PR, as a flow. Runs Axel Pliér as a hermiq agent step over the post-review context on the item and branches on the verdict. Replaces the hydra-owned applier container (images/applier) in the Claude path. See openspec/changes/hydra-flows-first-port task 4.1.

$bindings.judge.agentId: The uuid of the agent seeded from agents/axel-plier/hermiq-agent.json on the target instance. Instance-specific, so it cannot be checked in; an importer resolves it by the agent's name.

config.$comment: ⚠️ `===`, NOT `==`. json-logic-php's `==` is PHP's loose `==`, under which EVERY non-empty string equals `true` — so an applier answering `{"pass": "no"}` was routed to `go`. Measured live 2026-08-02. `default: "no-go"` was already right and is what makes an absent verdict safe; this makes a MALFORMED one safe too.

config.message: Applier returned pass. The verdict and its summary_comment are on the run's items; the caller transitions the label and merges.
Applier returned fail, or a verdict without pass:true. The blocking[] entries are on the run's items; the caller escalates to needs-input.
